findings.title: A cancelled turn settles as request.completed with task_state completed while its durable terminal reason is cancelled_by_user
findings.recommendation: Branch on view.terminal reason before the :completed case in settle_view and route cancelled_by_user to request.stopped with a non-completed task_state, reusing scheduled_terminal_status's reason-awareness and TerminalProgress::STOP_ACTIONS.

findings.title: Four of the six pinned profile budgets (steps, cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens) are accepted, pinned and recorded but never enforced; the agent cannot widen them, but the operator believes in a ceiling that does not exist
findings.recommendation: Iterate the profile's declared budget keys in exhausted_budget with a per-key evidence source (add steps from the committed checkpoint logical_step), or refuse the four unenforceable keys at DocumentValidator#budgets! so a pinned-but-inert ceiling is impossible.

findings.title: WorkerRuntime#build_child_session passes mcp: nil, so a child session built through the worker cannot reach the MCP source
findings.recommendation: Decide and state whether child tasks may reach MCP; if yes pass mcp: mcp_source in build_child_session, otherwise say so in the comment. No runtime consequence was proven in this audit.

findings.title: The headless_auto_approvals safety counter is a hardcoded 0 with no evidence expression, unlike its three sibling counters
findings.recommendation: Derive it from approval rows whose actor is a worker identity, or rename the field so status does not present an asserted constant as a measured counter. The underlying invariant is separately upheld at worker.rb:754-778.

findings.title: The budget gate rescans the whole effect journal on every settle, and the same settle scans it a second time for model-call telemetry
findings.recommendation: Use one census read per settle for both consumers and skip the budget gate entirely when thread_budgets is nil.

carried_forward.note: gems/tamoz-agent WorkerRuntime#session_for -> thread_profile -> load_profile re-resolves the current profiles/<id>.yaml with no read of the session's recorded profile_digest (worker_runtime.rb:701-706, 694-698, 820-824, 826-842); the child path DOES read it (1116-1123). Unchanged; not re-litigated.

EffectDispatcher#terminal_attempt still prefers any succeeded attempt and is still used by the :failed branch (effect_dispatcher.rb:97-101, 280-283). Reachability from F25 could NOT be established: session logical keys carry the execution id, so a session replay re-prepares instead of reaching the 'failed' head branch, and a :failed head with a repairable attempt-1 error returns action :execute. Owning seam remains tamoz-agent-kernel.

Runtime#initialize builds CapabilityBinding with neither profile nor mcp (runtime.rb:139) and admission_set appends all MCP names (capability_binding.rb:165-169). The unknown-descriptor governance fallback IS fail-closed (:bounded + tier ask, capability_binding.rb:206-209; policy_document.rb:57-75), which narrows but does not settle the admission contract. Contract decision still required.
